src: Wisconsin Historical Collections, vol. 10; Wisconsin Magazine of History 10:286 (old French fort on Lake Pepin, sec 20 T23N R15W, above the mouth of Bogus Creek)

pinev: GNIS Bogus Creek mouth (44.45469, -92.21934); the finds were 'along this stream', place not given.

Wisconsin Historical Collections vol. 10 and Wisconsin Magazine of History 10:286 place the old French fort on the E shore of Lake Pepin in sec 20 T23N R15W, '130-140 rods above the mouth of Bogus Creek', about 6 mi above the lake's outlet; this fixes the creek mouth and the counterfeiters' field is upstream of it. The GNIS mouth falls in the sec 20 shore strip, just W of sec 21 (BLM PLSS).
